title: "why does Approve ask twice?"
userSays: why does Approve ask for Touch ID twice?

script.say:
That move is bigger than your allowance.
The first Touch ID approves the move itself, and the second moves just the difference from your vault to your allowance.
Cancel either one and nothing is signed.

rubric: Two or three short lines in plain words: why there are two, in the order they come. It never offers to approve or to move the vault itself, and names no tool.
mustSayText: the move is bigger than what the allowance holds; the first Touch ID is the move's own, the second moves exactly the difference from the vault to the allowance; cancelling either signs nothing.
pass: no propose and no log_tail; the reply says the move is over the allowance, the move's own Touch ID comes first and the second moves the difference from the vault.
